sees: frame 1: Title 'THE ENTIRE SOCIETY BURNS' at top, badge 'INSIGHT 07 / 08 - REFUSAL', tag 'RED RISING'. A bald man in a dark jacket with a gold triangle emblem, frowning with a stern/worried face, extends his right arm pointing toward a second person. The second person, in a red overalls with dark curly hair, stands facing forward with a neutral face and wide eyes. Beige room with sunburst rays behind.
frame 2: Same staging. The pointing man's eyes look slightly toward the other person, frown persists. The red-clad person stays neutral, eyes looking sideways a bit.
frame 3: Same staging. The pointing man's eyes glance upward, still frowning and still pointing. The red-clad person's neutral face is unchanged, eyes looking forward/sideways.
changed: nothing meaningful; only tiny eye-direction shifts, characters and pose stay the same
message: The narrator is saying that a refusal or defiance by one person, in the face of an authority figure's accusation or command, would make the entire society burn.
wouldConfuse: The pointing gesture is ambiguous (accusing, ordering, or blaming), and nothing visual shows burning or any cause-and-effect; the relationship between the two people is unclear, and the red-clad person's neutral face gives no sign of refusal.
